title: Governed National Business Entity Resolution
description: Reversible physical-site and establishment aliases plus scored review candidates derived from source-preserving national registry location profiles.
ohio_reporting_boundary: Registry 2.15.0 binds Ohio reporting to its retained app source, preserves separate Ohio/Tennessee missing ZIP counts and excludes all Ohio site/establishment endpoints and source IDs from matching. Source membership is not independently verified identity or business completeness.
tennessee_reporting_boundary: Registry 2.13.0 recovered/schema1.0 and 2.14.0 fresh/schema1.1 Tennessee rows, including unavailable-ZIP records, are verified reporting-only inputs and never matching profiles or benchmark candidates. Cross-version rows are rejected. Compatibility is not production publication or independent identity-accuracy approval.
automatic_rules: exact complete normalized street address creates reversible physical-site aliases
exact eligible address plus exact non-generic name with one member per source release creates reversible establishment aliases
review_rule: Exact eligible address plus name evidence not eligible for an automatic establishment link creates an unapplied review candidate when its similarity score is at least 0.78; this includes similar non-exact names and exact names blocked as generic or source-ambiguous.

current_verified_release.scope_authority: The immutable release manifest is authoritative for complete source-specific coverage and limitations; this catalog stores exact headline totals only.
current_verified_release.export_policy: Local review only until benchmarked precision and contributing-source policy checks authorize an export.
